git.address_scheme: The repository address must start with https:// (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Gitea, Bitbucket). SSH addresses are not supported.
git.host_blocked: Connecting to '{host}' isn't allowed (private/internal network address).
git.response_too_large: The repository response is too large; the operation was stopped.
git.changed_meanwhile: The repository changed in the meantime. Update with "Pull from repository" first.
git.entry_too_large: '{path}' is too large or the folder has too many files.
git.auth_failed: Could not access the repository: authentication failed. Check the access token and its permissions.
git.not_found: The repository wasn't found or you don't have access. Check the address and the token permissions.
git.unreachable: Couldn't connect to the repository or it didn't respond.
